name: plesiosaurus
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-06, the sculpt overlay; generator scratchpad sc/sea3/gen/plesio.py): Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus, the Lower Jurassic marine reptile of Lyme Regis, 3.3 m -- NOT a dinosaur (a sauropterygian), so it is filed with the sea life and swims with the swimmers. A small DISTINCT head (25 cm, a little wider than the neck behind it: a short rounded-triangular skull, the eyes up and forward, the jaw's hinge behind them) on a neck about as long as the trunk (1.3 m, five bones, thick and fleshy at its root, tapering, curving gently up at rest); the trunk a deep broad barrel (1.2 m across, 0.66 deep, the back rounded); FOUR long hydrofoil flippers, elongated teardrops (a narrow wrist, broad in the middle, tapering to a swept-back point; 2026-11-07), the hind pair a little smaller, resting angled down; a short tapering tail; the jaws lined with small needle teeth leaning out and forward, interlocking. COUNTERSHADED (coatpat.js 43 `plesio`: the dark olive back crossfaded to a pale belly along the body's mid-height, finely blotched on top, a fine pebbled skin). It swims by UNDERWATER FLIGHT: each flipper flaps (axis x) and feathers (axis z, a quarter beat ahead) and its outer half bends behind, the hind pair a third of a stroke after the fore. It makes no sound. In the game it lives in the big lake (the Loch Ness wink: index.html seaLife, its head and neck breaking the surface now and then) and the open sea. SHARP PASS 2 (2026-11-08): the pointed parts -- toothL, toothU (22 in all) -- are the engine's sharp `horn`s (sharp.js), made from the field shapes they replaced by tools/creaturegen/sharp/ (claws.py, teeth.py, spikes.py, antlers.py, bills.py): rooted in the body, tips pointed; RE-RUN those after this species' generator.
